title: PEMAD-ESB-ScalTrain: training and evaluation of sea scallop object detectors on HabCam imagery
description: Slurm jobs and Python scripts that build the stratified HabCam training and evaluation sets, train YOLOv12n, RT-DETR-L and Cascade R-CNN (VIAME) scallop detectors, score them with Hungarian matching, and stage the Zenodo data record.
